bustSpanEase.name: Bust span ease (%)
bustSpanEase.help: Controls the amount of (horizontal) ease added to your bust span when locating the bust point.

chestEase.name: Chest ease (%)
chestEase.help: Controls the amount of ease at the fullest part of your chest

fullChestEaseReduction.name: Full chest ease reduction (%)
fullChestEaseReduction.help: Allows you to independently reduce the ease around the chest to make it fit tight(er) in that area

shoulderToShoulderEase.name: Shoulder to Shoulder ease (%)
shoulderToShoulderEase.help: Controls the amount of ease between your shoulders. Initially set to -.5% because Bella implements a block that is used in the industry.

waistEase.name: Waist ease (%)
waistEase.help: Controls the amount of ease at your waist

backHemSlope.name: Back hem slope (°)
backHemSlope.help: Controls the slope of the hem at the back

backNeckCutout.name: Back neck cutout (%)
backNeckCutout.help: Controls how deep the neck opening is scooped out at at the back

frontShoulderWidth.name: Front shoulder width (%)
frontShoulderWidth.help: Controls the narrowness of the front shoulders relative to the back

highBustWidth.name: High bust width (%)
highBustWidth.help: Allows you to tweak the high bust width at the front

armholeDepth.name: Armhole depth (%)
armholeDepth.help: Controls the depth of the armhole

backArmholeCurvature.name: Back armhole curvature (%)
backArmholeCurvature.help: Controls how deep the armhole is scooped out at the back bottom

backArmholePitchDepth.name: Back armhole pitch depth (%)
backArmholePitchDepth.help: Tweaks the horizontal placement of the back armhole pitch point

backArmholeSlant.name: Back armhole slant (°)
backArmholeSlant.help: Slightly rotates the armhole around its pitch point

frontArmholeCurvature.name: Front armhole curvature (%)
frontArmholeCurvature.help: Controls how deep the armhole is scooped out at the front bottom

frontArmholePitchDepth.name: Front armhole pitch depth (%)
frontArmholePitchDepth.help: Tweaks the horizontal placement of the front armhole pitch point

backDartHeight.name: Back dart height (%)
backDartHeight.help: Controls the height of the back dart

bustDartCurve.name: Bust dart curve (%)
bustDartCurve.help: Controls the curvature of the bust dart

bustDartLength.name: Bust dart length (%)
bustDartLength.help: Controls the length of the bust dart

bustDartAngle.name: Bust dart angle
bustDartAngle.help: The angle of the bust dart

bustDartMinimumFabric.name: Bust dart minimum fabric (%)
bustDartMinimumFabric.help: The minimum amount of side seam above and below the bust dart

waistDartLength.name: Waist dart length (%)
waistDartLength.help: Controls the length of the waist dart

waistDartCurve.name: Waist dart curve (%)
waistDartCurve.help: Controls the curvature of the waist dart
